Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The PRIDE metadata explicitly lists iTRAQ as the quantification method. The experimental design is an RNA-affinity pulldown (AP-MS) to identify protein interactors of a specific RNA element. scope: identify direct protein interactors of the SARS-CoV-2 frameshift RNA element using an in vitro RNA-antisense capture and mass spectrometry-based screen
The cleared lysate was incubated with in vitro transcribed RNA corresponding to the SARS-CoV-2 –1PRF site, which was immobilized on SA hydrophilic magnetic beads (NEB) by biotin-SA interaction
bound proteins were eluted by boiling the sample in 1× NuPAGE LDS sample buffer
For LC-MS/MS, the eluted proteins were alkylated using iodoacetamide followed by acetone precipitation

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment used RNA-antisense capture (affinity purification) to isolate proteins interacting with a specific RNA element from cell lysates. The material analyzed by MS consisted of the eluted bound proteins, not the whole cell lysate.
